Definition: Unique patient identifier (primary key of the ABT).
How it was calculated: Taken from the source data; one row per ID.
Cleaned age (typos like 158 -> 58 corrected, gaps filled with the patient's modal age); constant per patient.
Patient's modal gender across visits (conflicting minority entries corrected).
Source 'City of Residence' (never changed within a patient).
Modal profession; patients under 18 recoded to 'Student'.
Modal education level across visits (2 patients had isolated blanks).
Modal value across visits (minority typing errors corrected).

Definition: Disease in the family history (Cancer, Diabetes, Heart Disease, Hypertension) or 'None reported'.
How it was calculated: Source value; structural blanks recoded to 'None reported'.
Provider recorded on the patient's visits; recovered from the coverage rate where missing; blank + £0 coverage -> 'Uninsured'.
Median of the patient's valid recorded incomes (robust to visit-to-visit noise); recording errors > £500k excluded.

Definition: 1 if the patient is a doctor aged < 24 or a lawyer aged < 22 (unusual but plausible, kept).
How it was calculated: Max over the patient's visits of flag_atypical_age_profession.
pd.cut on Age: Child 0-11, Teen 12-17, Young Adult 18-34, Adult 35-49, Mature 50-64, Senior 65+.
'No income' if Annual_Income = 0; otherwise tertiles of positive incomes (Low <= £43,100 < Medium <= £46,200 < High).

Definition: Ordinal encoding of education (0 Pre-school ... 7 PhD).
How it was calculated: Mapping: Pre-school 0, Kindergarten 1, Elementary 2, Middle 3, High school 4, Undergraduate 5, Master 6, PhD 7.

Definition: 1 if the patient has an insurance provider, 0 if self-pay.
How it was calculated: Insurance_Provider != 'Uninsured'.

Definition: Share of the price the patient's provider pays (A 0.8, B 0.9, C 0.7, D 1.0, Uninsured 0).
How it was calculated: Rate learned from the data (median coverage / price per provider) and mapped to the provider.

Definition: 1 if any family disease is recorded.
How it was calculated: Family_History != 'None reported'.
Count of the patient's rows in the cleaned visit table.
nunique(Department) per patient.
Mean of Consultation Duration (invalid durations replaced by the patient's median).
Sample standard deviation of duration per patient.
Sum of Consultation Duration.

Definition: Department the patient visited most often.
How it was calculated: Mode of Department; ties broken alphabetically.

Definition: Share of the visits that went to the most frequent department.
How it was calculated: max(department count) / Total_Visits.

Definition: How spread the visits are over departments (0 = one department, 1 = evenly over all 13).
How it was calculated: Shannon entropy of the department shares divided by ln(13).
Count of rows with Department = 'Emergency'.

Definition: Share of visits that were Emergency.
How it was calculated: Emergency_Visits / Total_Visits.
Count of the patient's rows with Department = 'Allergology'.
Count of the patient's rows with Department = 'Cardiology'.
Count of the patient's rows with Department = 'Dermatology'.
Count of the patient's rows with Department = 'ENT'.
Count of the patient's rows with Department = 'Emergency'.
Count of the patient's rows with Department = 'Endocrinology'.
Count of the patient's rows with Department = 'Gastroenterology'.

Definition: Number of visits to General Practice.
How it was calculated: Count of the patient's rows with Department = 'General Practice'.
Count of the patient's rows with Department = 'Neurology'.
Count of the patient's rows with Department = 'Orthopedics'.
Count of the patient's rows with Department = 'Psychiatry'.
Count of the patient's rows with Department = 'Pulmonology'.
Count of the patient's rows with Department = 'Rheumatology'.

Definition: Total consultation price over the period (£).
How it was calculated: Sum of Consultation Price (before insurance).
Mean of Consultation Price.
Max of Consultation Price.
Sum of Insurance Coverage (recomputed as rate x price where it was missing or inconsistent).
Sum over visits of (Consultation Price - Insurance Coverage).
Total_Insurance_Coverage / Total_Visits.
Total_Out_of_Pocket / Total_Visits.

Definition: Share of the total bill paid by the insurer (0-1).
How it was calculated: Total_Insurance_Coverage / Total_Spent.

Definition: Share of the total bill paid by the patient (0-1).
How it was calculated: Total_Out_of_Pocket / Total_Spent = 1 - Insurance_Coverage_Ratio.
Mean of Satisfaction Level over valid ratings only (the invalid '6' is excluded).
Min of valid ratings.
Max of valid ratings.
Sample std of valid ratings (0 if only one rating).

Definition: Number of valid ratings available for the patient.
How it was calculated: Count of non-missing Satisfaction Level after cleaning.

Definition: Share of valid ratings that are low (1 or 2).
How it was calculated: mean(rating <= 2) over valid ratings.

Definition: Share of valid ratings that are high (4 or 5).
How it was calculated: mean(rating >= 4) over valid ratings.
Rating of the latest visit that has a valid rating.

Definition: Direction of the experience: change in rating per 30 days (>0 improving).
How it was calculated: Slope of a least-squares line rating ~ time; 0 if < 3 ratings or all on one day.

Definition: Number of ratings discarded as invalid (value 6).
How it was calculated: Total_Visits - N_Valid_Ratings. Useful as a data-reliability indicator.

Definition: Date of the first visit in the period.
How it was calculated: min(Visit Date).

Definition: Date of the last visit in the period.
How it was calculated: max(Visit Date).

Definition: Days between the last visit and the reference date 1 July 2024.
How it was calculated: (2024-07-01 - Last_Visit_Date).days.

Definition: Days between the first visit and the reference date.
How it was calculated: (2024-07-01 - First_Visit_Date).days.

Definition: Days between the first and the last visit.
How it was calculated: (Last_Visit_Date - First_Visit_Date).days.
Count of rows with Visit Date in Jan 2024.
Count of rows with Visit Date in Feb 2024.
Count of rows with Visit Date in Mar 2024.
Count of rows with Visit Date in Apr 2024.
Count of rows with Visit Date in May 2024.
Count of rows with Visit Date in Jun 2024.
Total_Visits / 6 (observation window = 6 months).

Definition: Number of months (of 6) with at least one visit.
How it was calculated: Count of monthly columns > 0.
Tenure_Days / (Total_Visits - 1).

Definition: Change in activity: visits in Apr-Jun minus visits in Jan-Mar (>0 growing).
How it was calculated: sum(Visits_Apr..Jun) - sum(Visits_Jan..Mar).
